prompt: Name a playable character in the original Super Smash Bros. on the Nintendo 64.
source: Super Smash Bros. (1999, Nintendo 64) character roster.
valueLogic: The eight starting characters sit low to mid - anyone who played the game saw them immediately. The four unlockables are the tail, because they had to be earned: Luigi, Captain Falcon, Ness and Jigglypuff. Ness and Jigglypuff are the genuine deep cuts, since plenty of players never unlocked them at all.
note: Characters from later Smash games are non-busting distractors, so nobody busts for naming Zelda, Marth or Sonic.

answers.name: Mario
answers.fact: On the starting roster, and the face of the whole thing.

answers.name: Pikachu
answers.fact: On the starting roster, and the only Pokemon among the eight starters.

answers.name: Link
answers.fact: On the starting roster, from The Legend of Zelda.

answers.name: Kirby
answers.fact: On the starting roster, and the only one who can copy another fighter's move.

answers.name: Samus
answers.fact: On the starting roster, from Metroid.

answers.name: Fox
answers.fact: On the starting roster, from Star Fox.

answers.name: Luigi
answers.fact: Unlockable, by clearing Break the Targets with all eight starters.

answers.name: Captain Falcon
answers.fact: Unlockable, from F-Zero, a racing series where he's rarely seen out of his car.

answers.name: Ness
answers.fact: Unlockable, from EarthBound - a game most players outside Japan had never heard of.

answers.name: Jigglypuff
answers.fact: The last unlockable, and the hardest of the twelve to name.

distractors.name: Zelda
distractors.note: Added in Melee, not in the original twelve.

distractors.name: Master Hand
distractors.note: The final boss, never playable in the original.
